This is invisible to any single-process test suite and only shows up under real concurrent, multi-process load (or by inspecting the storage backend).

Click analytics has the same shape of problem at a smaller scale: an in-process counter increment isn't atomic across concurrent requests without DB-level atomicity (`UPDATE ... SET clicks = clicks + 1`, not read-modify-write in Python).
